_comment: GROUND TRUTH — NEVER EXPOSE TO THE AI AGENT DURING INVESTIGATION
_description: This file is used ONLY by the evaluation framework to assess RootTrace accuracy

INC-001.title: Payment API latency increased 300% after latest deployment
INC-001.root_cause_description: db_pool_size was set to None in config.py, removing the connection pool limit. Under load, SQLAlchemy opened unlimited connections until PostgreSQL's max_connections (100) was reached, causing all subsequent connection attempts to timeout.
disqualifying_evidence: slow SQL query (this is a separate incident INC-002)
INC-001.notes: The agent should find: DEP-001 at 10:20, db_connections=100 at 10:26, timeout errors at 10:27. The deployment-to-incident timeline should be identified.

INC-002.title: Payment history endpoint latency degradation
INC-002.root_cause_description: repository.py was changed to use a correlated subquery instead of a direct WHERE clause. This results in N+1 database queries for payment history retrieval, causing 30ms queries to degrade to 900ms+.
disqualifying_evidence: db_connections at max (this is INC-001, not INC-002)

INC-003.title: Payment API memory usage increasing continuously — OOM expected
INC-003.root_cause_description: cache.py introduced a module-level dictionary with no eviction policy or size limit. Every payment ID is cached permanently. Under normal traffic, memory usage grows from 40% → 95% over 4-6 hours until OOM kill.
required_evidence: no cache eviction in cache.py diff

INC-004.title: Payment API latency correlated with fraud service degradation
INC-004.root_cause_description: fraud_service.py was changed to use timeout=None (infinite wait). When fraud-service latency increased from 50ms to 8000ms, payment API requests waited indefinitely, causing cascading latency increase.
required_evidence: payment API latency follows fraud-service latency
no database connection errors (distinguishes from INC-001)
disqualifying_evidence: database connection pool exhaustion (rules out INC-001)
INC-004.notes: This incident tests whether the agent can distinguish database latency from external service latency. Evidence of fraud-service metrics is critical.

INC-005.title: Authentication failures — all API requests returning 401
INC-005.root_cause_description: auth.py changed algorithms=["HS256"] to algorithms=["RS256"] in jwt.decode(). All tokens issued with HS256 now fail validation. All authenticated endpoints return 401.
required_evidence: tokens still being issued correctly (issue is in validation)
INC-005.notes: This is the most clear-cut incident. The code change is unambiguous. The agent should achieve high confidence.
